description: Performance rules evaluated against a Power BI Desktop Performance Analyzer export (performanceAnalyzerExport.schema.json). Thresholds are editable. Severity 1 (minor) .. 5 (critical).

rules.name: Visual total time is slow
rules.description: A visual's total time (DAX query + visual display + other) exceeds 1000 ms. Slow visuals hurt the user experience.
rules.remediation: Reduce the data the visual pulls, simplify the DAX, reduce the number of fields/series, or split into smaller visuals.

rules.name: Visual total time is very slow
rules.description: A visual takes more than 3000 ms end to end. This is a critical bottleneck users will notice immediately.
rules.remediation: Prioritise this visual: optimise its DAX measures, add aggregations, reduce cardinality, or reconsider the visual design.

rules.name: DAX query is slow
rules.description: The DAX query behind the visual takes more than 500 ms. DAX time usually dominates slow visuals.
rules.remediation: Optimise measures (avoid iterators over large tables, prefer DIVIDE, use variables), check relationships/filters, and consider aggregations or Import over DirectQuery.

rules.name: DAX query is very slow
rules.description: A single DAX query takes more than 2000 ms.
rules.remediation: Capture the query text, analyse it in DAX Studio (server timings), and rewrite the hottest measure. Consider pre-aggregated tables.

rules.name: Visual display (render) is slow
rules.description: The visual display / rendering time exceeds 500 ms, independent of the query.
rules.remediation: Reduce data points plotted, disable unnecessary visual features, avoid very high category counts, or use a lighter visual type. Custom visuals are often slower.

rules.name: High 'Other' time (overhead)
rules.description: 'Other' time (waiting in queue, preparing queries, blocked by other visuals) exceeds 300 ms. Often caused by too many visuals competing on the page.
rules.remediation: Reduce the number of visuals on the page, avoid visual interactions that trigger many simultaneous queries, and turn off unnecessary cross-highlighting.

rules.name: DirectQuery used by visual
rules.description: The visual issued one or more DirectQuery calls to the source. DirectQuery adds network/source latency on every interaction.
rules.remediation: Consider Import mode or composite models with aggregations for hot tables; ensure source indexes and query folding are in place.

rules.name: Too many visuals captured
rules.description: More than 30 visuals were measured in the capture. Many visuals on one page increase 'Other' time and total load.
rules.remediation: Limit to the visuals users need per page, use bookmarks/drillthrough, and split dense pages.

rules.name: Total captured time is high
rules.description: The sum of all DAX query time across the capture exceeds 5000 ms, indicating the interaction as a whole is query-heavy.
rules.remediation: Identify the top query-time visuals (see the ranked table) and optimise them first; add aggregations for shared measures.

rules.name: DAX dominates a slow visual
rules.description: For a visual slower than 1000 ms, DAX query time is more than 70% of the total — the model/measures are the bottleneck (not rendering).
rules.remediation: Focus optimisation on the DAX/measure layer for this visual rather than the visual configuration.
